description: This file defines the implementation of the DefaultMessageMapperRegistry class, which manages different MessageMapper instances, including default, custom, and fallback mappers, for payload mapping in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: DefaultMessageMapperRegistry
classes.description: Implementation of MessageMapperRegistry that manages default, custom, and fallback mappers, providing methods to retrieve, validate, and compare mapper configurations.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new DefaultMessageMapperRegistry instance with specified mappers.

methods.name: getMappers
methods.description: Returns a list of MessageMappers based on the provided PayloadMapping.

methods.name: resolveMessageMapper
methods.description: Resolves and returns the appropriate MessageMapper for a given string id, searching custom mappers, fallback mappers, or default mapper.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality with another DefaultMessageMapperRegistry object based on internal mappers.

methods.name: validatePayloadMapping
methods.description: Validates each mapper in the PayloadMapping, throwing exception if any cannot be loaded.

methods.name: validateMessageMapper
methods.description: Validates that a specific mapper id can be resolved to a MessageMapper, or throws an exception.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on internal mappers.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the registry.
